notes: sizeGb = download at the given quant. Numbers from the October 2026 model research (schools/eka/docs/INFRA.md, Models right now / Decision models); 'est' marks an estimate. Tasks: page (single-file web page), agent (multi-step coding), chat, decision, estonian.

models.name: Clef-flash (decision model)
models.note: Answers typed questions with probabilities; ~0.3 s for 1k tokens on M5 Max. Needs Ollama >= 0.35.1 (/v1/systemone).

models.name: Qwen 3.5 9B
models.note: Fits 16 GB laptops; fine for chat and small edits, weak at whole pages and Estonian.

models.name: Ornith 1.0 9B
models.note: Agent-tuned small model (vendor: SWE-bench Verified 69); demos only for multi-step work.

models.name: gpt-oss 20B
models.note: Needs ~16 GB of GPU memory: fits a 16 GB GPU, not a 16 GB Mac.

models.name: Qwen 3.8 27B
models.note: Strongest small model (SWE-bench Verified 86, Vals). Dense, so slow on Macs. Same model the course runs on Workers AI.

models.name: Qwen 3.6 35B-A3B
models.note: Mixture of experts: much faster than its size suggests (~32-46 tok/s on M4 Pro/Max).

models.name: DiffusionGemma 26B-A4B
models.note: Writes by denoising, not word by word: a model type to look at, not a page-maker.

models.name: Llama 3.1 EstLLM 8B (TartuNLP)
models.note: Built for Estonian; no tool calling. For language probes, not agents.
